verses.1: A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, then we thought we were dreaming.
verses.2: Our mouths were filled with laughter; our tongues sang for joy. Then it was said among the nations, "The LORD had done great things for them."
verses.3: The LORD has done great things for us; Oh, how happy we were!
verses.4: Restore again our fortunes, LORD, like the dry stream beds of the Negeb.
verses.5: Those who sow in tears will reap with cries of joy.
verses.6: Those who go forth weeping, carrying sacks of seed, Will return with cries of joy, carrying their bundled sheaves.

notes.text: Like the dry stream beds of the Negeb: the psalmist prays for rain in such abundance that the dry riverbeds will run.
